calculation.expression: -rolling_mean_3((log(C/C[-10])/vol20 - log(C[-10]/C[-20])/vol20)) with trend-level normalization and 3-day smoothing
calculation.description: The negative of normalized fast-minus-slow trend curvature. Positive values represent decelerating or reversing recent trends and are expected to forecast higher 10-session returns in this benchmark.

validation.regime_notes: Positive aggregate IC across the full online-era sample; strongest inverse-curvature behavior in recent windows, with conservative interpretation due to 15-asset cross-section.
